question_text: In the past month, have you had a desire to die or to go to sleep and never wake up?
In the past month, have you had any thoughts that you would like to kill yourself?
Have you been thinking about how you might kill yourself?
How much do you want to act on these thoughts?
Have you started to work out the details of how you would kill yourself? Do you intend to carry out this plan?

In the past four weeks, have you done anything, started doing anything, or prepared to do anything to end your life? Examples include collecting medication, obtaining a gun, giving away belongings, writing a suicide note, taking pills but not swallowing them, holding a gun but not pulling the trigger, going to a high place but not jumping, swallowing a small number of pills, or attempting self-harm or suicide.
